- When `settings.screenConfigNotifier.value` is a `CassetteScreenConfig`, the **cassette variant** control (`void-settings-cassette-variant`) now renders **immediately below** the **screen** setting row (`void-settings-screen`).
- The control’s existing cycling behavior is preserved.
- The rest of the cassette controls (**text size** + **haptics**) remain in the existing per-screen **DISPLAY** cluster.

Screenshot (Linux, Cassette selected):  
![Cassette settings region](/workspace/.tmp/agent_shots/cassette_settings_region.png)

Implemented the UI reorder in **`lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart`**:

- When `settings.screenConfigNotifier.value` is a `CassetteScreenConfig`, the **cassette variant** control (`void-settings-cassette-variant`) now renders **immediately below** the **screen** setting row (`void-settings-screen`).
- The control’s existing cycling behavior is preserved.
- The rest of the cassette controls (**text size** + **haptics**) remain in the existing per-screen **DISPLAY** cluster.
